hypotheses.justification: The hypothesis is never used in the proof: the second calc step is `rfl`, and the first step is `moment_permute H raw3713 permutation33 permutation10`, whose statement in `OAI.MUB6.Certificate.Canonical` is unconditional: `theorem moment_permute {p q : ℕ} (H : CMatrix) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) ℤ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin p)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin q)) : injectiveMoment H A = injectiveMoment H (fun i j => A (σ i) (τ j))`, proved from `injectiveMoment_row_permutation`/`injectiveMoment_column_permutation`, which also take no Hadamard hypothesis (unlike `injectiveMoment_neg`, which does need `IsHadamard`). The conclusion `injectiveMoment H raw3713 = injectiveMoment H node2072` mentions only `H : CMatrix`, so no Hadamard structure on `H` is required and the same proof goes through after deleting the binder (its name is even prefixed with `_`).
